meta.title: Blog and stories
meta.description: Write blog posts and stories, schedule them and publish them.

adminBlog.title: Blog and stories
adminBlog.lead: Write a post as a draft, add its images, then publish it now or schedule it for later.

denied.title: Only content managers can open this page
denied.body: Writing blog posts and stories is for content managers. Ask a super admin if you need the role.

notFound.title: There is no such post
notFound.body: It may have been typed wrongly. Every post is listed on the blog page.

list.empty: There are no posts yet. Start one with New post.
list.caption: Every post, the most recently changed first

new.title: New post
new.lead: Save it as a draft first. You can add images, preview it and publish it once it is saved.

edit.archivedOn: Archived {date}. Restore it to edit it again.

form.heading: The post
form.title: Title
form.slugHint: Lower-case words joined by hyphens, as in kite-season. Leave it blank to make one from the title.
form.excerptHint: One or two sentences under the title and on cards, up to 300 characters. A draft can leave it for later.
form.seoTitleHint: A shorter title for search results and the browser tab, needed when the title is long.
form.easyReadHint: One or two short sentences a young reader understands, up to 200 characters.
form.authorNameHint: The name shown as the byline. Optional.
form.topicsHint: Words separated by commas, as in kites, street-dogs.
form.coverHint: An image you uploaded below, or a photo from the site's library. Without one, the post shows a tile pattern.
form.sourceHint: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Write ## for a heading, - for a list, *emphasis*, **strong** and [words](https://example.org) for a link. Put an uploaded image in with @image and its id.

errors.taken: Another post has this web address. Choose another.
errors.invalid_format: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens only.
errors.invalid: This value isn't one we can save.

alerts.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was saved. Please try again.
alerts.unknownImage: The text or the cover names an image that isn't one of this post's. Upload it below first.
alerts.imageNotReady: An image isn't ready yet. Wait a minute for its resized copies, then save again.
alerts.archived: This post is archived. Restore it before you edit it.

sourceErrors.empty_mark: There is nothing between the marks.
sourceErrors.unclosed_link: A link has no closing bracket.
sourceErrors.invalid_link: A link's address isn't one we allow.
sourceErrors.invalid_footnote_ref: A source mark should look like [^f1].
sourceErrors.unknown_footnote: This line cites a source that isn't listed.
sourceErrors.invalid_footnote: A source needs its title and its web address in angle brackets.
sourceErrors.unknown_quote: There is no quote with that id.
sourceErrors.invalid_image: An image needs the id of one of this post's images, or site: and a photo's id.
sourceErrors.unknown_site_image: There is no site photo with that id.
sourceErrors.unknown_directive: Only @quote and @image start a line with @.
sourceErrors.invalid_source_quote: A quote's last line should be — who said it, and a source mark.
sourceErrors.dangling_escape: A backslash ends the line with nothing after it.

images.heading: Images
images.lead: Upload a cover or an image for the text. The site only ever shows resized copies, never the file you upload.
images.consent: Upload a photo that shows a child only if a parent or guardian has agreed in writing to it being published. Never name the child or their school in the image or its alt text.
images.caption: This post's images
images.altHint: What the image shows, for people who can't see it. A cover needs it before the post goes live.

upload.label: Image file
upload.hint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP image, up to 20 MB.
upload.ready: Uploaded. Its resized copies are being made: reload the page in a minute.
upload.slow: The check is taking longer than usual. Reload the page in a few minutes.

errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then upload the image.
errors.typeNotAllowed: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload didn't finish. Please try again.
errors.uploadRejected: The file that arrived wasn't the one chosen. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

publishing.heading: Publishing
publishing.draftLead: Publish it now, or choose when it goes live.
publishing.scheduledLead: It goes live {date}. Publish it now, choose another time or take it back to a draft.
publishing.publishedLead: It is live. Archive it to take it off the site.
publishing.archivedLead: It is off the site. Restore it as a draft to edit it again.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.lead: The saved text as it will read. Uploaded images show here by their alt text.

notices.published: Published. The blog shows it now.
notices.archived: Archived. It is off the site.

refused.not_in_future: Choose a time in the future.
refused.invalid_instant: That isn't a date and time we can read.
refused.invalid_transition: That can't be done to a post in this state.
refused.image_not_ready: An image isn't ready yet. Wait a minute for its resized copies, then try again.
refused.invalid_input: It isn't ready to go live: a field it needs is missing or too long, such as the summary, the search title or the cover's alt text. Fix it in the form and save first.
refused.cover_alt_required: This post is live or scheduled, so its cover needs alt text. Say what the image shows.
refused.too_long: That alt text is too long.
refused.archived: This post is archived. Restore it first.
refused.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing changed. Please try again.
